text:
This is not a list of promises. It’s a list of laws enacted, cases won, policies implemented, agreements secured, and measurable results.
You don’t have to memorize all 25. Learn five. And when somebody says Trump “hasn’t done much,” show them the receipts.
Trump Restored American Safety and Sovereignty
1. He made the border a real border again.
In a matter of months, Trump reduced illegal border crossings to their lowest level in half a century. Catch-and-release is finished. The wall is going up and even being expanded, “Remain in Mexico” is back, and the Administration reduced releases into the country by an incredible 99.9 percent.
2. He reversed mass migration.
America recorded negative net migration in 2025 for the first time in at least half a century. So far, nearly 3 million illegal aliens have left the country, whether voluntarily or involuntarily: more than 675,000 forcibly deported and the rest “self-deported.”
Many of those self-deportations were facilitated by the President’s innovative program to offer plane tickets and cash bonuses for illegals to leave, not only incentivizing good behavior but significantly reducing the cost of deportations. Citizenship and the law actually mean something again.
3. He signed the Laken Riley Act — and required detention of criminal illegal aliens.
Named for an innocent girl murdered by an illegal alien, the Laken Riley Act requires federal authorities to detain illegals arrested for theft, burglary, shoplifting, assaulting police, or any crime causing death or serious injury. It also lets states sue officials who refuse to enforce it.
Laken Riley should still be alive. This law will prevent tragedies like hers.
4. History’s biggest drop in violent crime, and the lowest violent crime rate in 126 years.
According to FBI data, violent crime in America dropped an incredible 9.7 percent in 2025 — the largest one-year decline in history. Murder fell 18.1 percent, robbery fell 18.5 percent. And America’s violent crime rate is its lowest since 1900.
This is what happens when you put the National Guard on the streets in crime-ridden blue cities: fewer victims, safer streets, and better futures for America’s poorest.
Trump Launched an American Industrial Supercycle
5. He made the 2017 tax cuts permanent…and better.
The One Big Beautiful Bill locked in the largest tax cut in modern history, including the doubled standard deduction, the expanded Child Tax Credit, and 100 percent expensing for factories and equipment. It also delivered No Tax on Tips, No Tax on Overtime, an abolition of most taxes on Social Security benefits, and major relief for seniors.
Every Democrat voted no. With the 2017 act set to expire in December 2025, that would have resulted in the largest tax hike in American history.
6. He repealed 129 regulations for every new one.
In fiscal 2025, federal agencies finalized 646 deregulatory actions and just five regulatory actions: 129-to-1, and in nearly every case, the “one” was to repeal the others! OIRA says the savings exceeded those of Trump’s entire first term. That is more freedom, lower costs, and less bureaucratic sabotage.
Of these, the crown jewel was the repeal of Obama’s 2009 “Endangerment Finding”, the legal foundation for the Green New Scam’s vehicle mandates. EPA calls it the largest deregulatory action in American history and estimates that by itself, it will save Americans more than $1.3 trillion. Trump also killed the federal EV mandate, restored Americans’ freedom to buy the cars and trucks they actually want, and even eliminated the incentives behind the almost universally hated start-stop button.
7. He secured $18 trillion in announced investment commitments.
That’s nearly two-thirds the size of the entire American economy, building American factories, chip plants, data centers, energy projects, steel mills, shipyards, and supply chains employing American workers. Apple, Meta, NVIDIA, Micron, Hyundai, U.S. Steel, Ford, Taiwan Semiconductor, and many corporations and sovereign wealth funds are betting big on Trump’s America.
No President has ever done anything remotely like it. And it’s just getting started.
8. He made “reshoring” and “reindustrialization” real, not a slogan.
Ford is moving Lincoln production out of China. Toyota is shifting Tacoma production from Mexico to Texas. GM, Honda, Mercedes-Benz, Stellantis, and others are expanding U.S. production. The capital equipment pouring into the country is the machinery that’s building the growing boom.
9. He replaced lopsided trade deals with balanced, reciprocal trade.
Trump used tariffs as leverage to reverse 80 years of lopsided trade deals that favored everyone but America, and to win new or improved agreements with trading partners accounting for more than half of global GDP. Those agreements open foreign markets, attack non-tariff barriers, defend strategic industries, and make it more profitable to build in America than to export American jobs.
10. He shifted global energy dominance from the Persian Gulf to the Gulf of America.
Once the world’s largest energy importer — “exporting” $700 billion a year to our enemies — America now outproduces Saudi Arabia and Russia combined. The U.S. is also setting new records in oil, natural gas, and LNG exports, becoming the first country ever to export more than 100 million metric tons of LNG in a year.
Trump also opened land, accelerated permits, expanded pipelines and export terminals, and made American energy a tool for prosperity and peace.
11. After four decades of nuclear paralysis, Trump brought five new reactors online in a single year.
For more than 40 years, not one new privately developed non-light-water reactor reached criticality in America. Trump ordered at least three by July 4, 2026. DOE delivered four by the deadline, then a fifth just one month later.
Decades of zero. One Trump summer: five. That is a genuine nuclear renaissance.
Trump Made Elections Matter Again
12. He broke the Deep State’s power to defy the elected branches.
In Trump v. Slaughter, the Supreme Court ruled for the first time in 90 years that Article 2, Section 1 is still part of the Constitution: the President may fire subordinate officials in the executive branch, overturning the 1935 precedent that insulated “independent” agencies from voters’ control.
Ever wonder why elections often seem to change nothing? How about one President and 5,000 political appointees vs. 2.8 million unfireable, unaccountable bureaucrats? THAT is the “Deep State”.
Trump then made that victory real. For the first time in a century, all policy-making bureaucrats can now be fired for misconduct, incompetence, or defying lawful directives. The permanent bureaucracy no longer gets to veto the voters.
13. He ended nationwide injunction abuse.
In Trump v. CASA, the Supreme Court sharply limited nationwide injunctions. A single, local, district judge should not be able to block a national policy for everyone, everywhere; and yet that’s exactly what they’ve done, nonstop, ever since Trump (and only Trump) took office in 2017.
In restricting that unconstitutional power, the Court kneecapped the Black Robe Bureaucracy’s favorite tool of unlawful judicial supremacy.
14. He shut down USAID as a left-wing slush fund and shadow government.
USAID had become a taxpayer-funded machine for exporting abortion, gender ideology, censorship, and left-wing politics. It had a bigger budget than the CIA and the State Department combined, absolutely no accountability whatsoever, and a penchant for overthrowing governments.
Trump terminated it — completely — and moved real humanitarian aid under the State Department. Immediately, seven socialist Latin American governments lost re-election. Coincidence?
15. He shrank Federal employment to its lowest level in 60 years.
From a high under Biden, the federal workforce is now its smallest since 1966. Workforce reductions, agency closures, and spending cancellations mean fewer bureaucrats paid to resist the voters.
What’s more, when Biden left office, 94 percent of federal employees “worked” from home. The Trump administration cracked down: as Elon Musk put it, “you can work from the office or you can pretend to work somewhere else.”
16. He expelled DEI from the federal government.
Trump eliminated federal DEI offices and barred race- and sex-based preferences across the executive branch. Government hiring and contracting are returning to merit and equality under the law, ending the grotesque Democrat idea that “fighting discrimination” requires the federal government to discriminate.
He Defended Faith and Family
17. He delivered sweeping pro-life reform.
In his first term, Trump delivered the judges that overturned the abominable Roe v. Wade. Hardly anyone believed it could be done, or that Trump would do it. But he did, and a half-century nightmare finally ended.
Since returning to office, Trump has enforced the Hyde Amendment prohibiting the use of federal funds to pay for abortions, reinstated and expanded the Mexico City Policy prohibiting federal funding of foreign abortions, ended federal fetal-tissue research, strengthened conscience protections, protected Medicaid from funding large abortion providers, and pardoned 23 pro-life activists prosecuted by Biden’s weaponized Justice Department.
He’s also done everything within the Executive Branch’s power to defund Planned Parenthood. It would be nice if Congress did likewise.
No President has ever done more to protect life. No one.
18. He got men out of women’s sports, and restored biological reality to federal policy.
The United States government once again officially recognizes two sexes: male and female. Trump ended federal support for the chemical and surgical gender mutilation of children, stopped taxpayer funding of such irreversible abominations, and forced more than three dozen health systems to end or suspend their programs as well.
Trump also enforced Title IX as written: women and girls deserve their own teams, trophies, scholarships, and locker rooms. The NCAA and other athletic organizations changed their rules in response. After years of Democrats doing everything they could to destroy women’s sports and ruin girls’ lives, Trump’s administration protects women and girls again.
19. He enacted America’s first nationwide school-choice program — and launched Trump Accounts.
As part of the President’s One Big Beautiful Bill, Trump enacted America’s first-ever nationwide school choice program. The new Education Freedom Tax Credit helps fund scholarships for tuition, books, and other educational costs.
That’s on top of the new Trump Accounts, which give every child a tax-advantaged stake in America’s future, including a $1,000 federal seed for eligible newborns. Parents gain power. Bureaucracies lose it. And children learn first-hand about free markets and future orientation.
20. He targeted anti-Christian bias and discrimination.
Trump created the White House Faith Office, Religious Liberty Commission, and Task Force to Eradicate Anti-Christian Bias. He restored conscience protections and made clear that Christians do not surrender their First Amendment rights merely by entering public life.
He Restored Peace Through Strength and Put America First
21. He forced NATO to stop freeloading and increase defense spending by 250 percent.
For decades, wealthy European governments underfunded their militaries, effectively sending America the bill and using American taxpayers to subsidize their bloated welfare states. Trump forced NATO to replace its old two-percent-of-GDP spending target with an enormous five percent by 2035.
Allied spending is rising, American defense orders are soaring, and Europe is becoming a partner instead of a dependent.
22. He drove China out of the Caribbean.
China spent years building strategic beachheads at both ends of the Panama Canal, in Cuba, and in Maduro’s Venezuela. Trump forced Panama out of Belt and Road, expanded American security access around the Canal, and captured Maduro, who now sits in a New York jail cell awaiting trial.
Beijing’s planned encirclement of the United States collapsed. The Monroe Doctrine is back. Call it the Donroe Doctrine.
23. He brokered eight peace deals in just eight months.
In eight months, Trump brokered peace in eight conflicts spanning four continents, including wars that had gone on for as much as 40 years. It’s a record unmatched by any other President.
24. He launched and funded Golden Dome, the first-ever true missile defense for the U.S. population.
Ronald Reagan dreamed of making nuclear missiles obsolete through his Strategic Defense Initiative. Today, Trump is actually building it: a layered homeland shield with space-based sensors and interceptors, conventional defenses, and new technologies including microwave systems to destroy drone swarms and directed-energy weapons (yes, lasers) that can replace an $11 million missile with $2 of electricity.
Congress has funded the initial $25 billion, with far more on the way once it passes the NDAA this fall. Better a shield than a sword.
25. He restored the warrior ethos — and reversed the recruiting crisis.
After years of missed targets under Biden, every active military component met or exceeded its 2025 recruiting goal. Trump and Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth refocused the newly renamed Department of War on actually winning wars, while pouring resources into shipbuilding, munitions, drones, missile defense, and America’s atrophied industrial base.
Young Americans once again believe their Commander-in-Chief is worth serving. And they’re showing up en masse.
Now Act Like It Matters
Those are not tweets or campaign promises. They are changes in law, power, investment, sovereignty, culture, and the structure of the Republic itself. And they’re just the top 25: I could give you hundreds more.

Trump Launched an American Industrial Supercycle
5. He made the 2017 tax cuts permanent…and better.
The One Big Beautiful Bill locked in the largest tax cut in modern history, including the doubled standard deduction, the expanded Child Tax Credit, and 100 percent expensing for factories and equipment. It also delivered No Tax on Tips, No Tax on Overtime, an abolition of most taxes on Social Security benefits, and major relief for seniors.
Every Democrat voted no. With the 2017 act set to expire in December 2025, that would have resulted in the largest tax hike in American history.
6. He repealed 129 regulations for every new one.
In fiscal 2025, federal agencies finalized 646 deregulatory actions and just five regulatory actions: 129-to-1, and in nearly every case, the “one” was to repeal the others! OIRA says the savings exceeded those of Trump’s entire first term. That is more freedom, lower costs, and less bureaucratic sabotage.
Of these, the crown jewel was the repeal of Obama’s 2009 “Endangerment Finding”, the legal foundation for the Green New Scam’s vehicle mandates. EPA calls it the largest deregulatory action in American history and estimates that by itself, it will save Americans more than $1.3 trillion. Trump also killed the federal EV mandate, restored Americans’ freedom to buy the cars and trucks they actually want, and even eliminated the incentives behind the almost universally hated start-stop button.
7. He secured $18 trillion in announced investment commitments.
That’s nearly two-thirds the size of the entire American economy, building American factories, chip plants, data centers, energy projects, steel mills, shipyards, and supply chains employing American workers. Apple, Meta, NVIDIA, Micron, Hyundai, U.S. Steel, Ford, Taiwan Semiconductor, and many corporations and sovereign wealth funds are betting big on Trump’s America.
No President has ever done anything remotely like it. And it’s just getting started.
8. He made “reshoring” and “reindustrialization” real, not a slogan.
Ford is moving Lincoln production out of China. Toyota is shifting Tacoma production from Mexico to Texas. GM, Honda, Mercedes-Benz, Stellantis, and others are expanding U.S. production. The capital equipment pouring into the country is the machinery that’s building the growing boom.
9. He replaced lopsided trade deals with balanced, reciprocal trade.
Trump used tariffs as leverage to reverse 80 years of lopsided trade deals that favored everyone but America, and to win new or improved agreements with trading partners accounting for more than half of global GDP. Those agreements open foreign markets, attack non-tariff barriers, defend strategic industries, and make it more profitable to build in America than to export American jobs.
10. He shifted global energy dominance from the Persian Gulf to the Gulf of America.
Once the world’s largest energy importer — “exporting” $700 billion a year to our enemies — America now outproduces Saudi Arabia and Russia combined. The U.S. is also setting new records in oil, natural gas, and LNG exports, becoming the first country ever to export more than 100 million metric tons of LNG in a year.
Trump also opened land, accelerated permits, expanded pipelines and export terminals, and made American energy a tool for prosperity and peace.
11. After four decades of nuclear paralysis, Trump brought five new reactors online in a single year.
For more than 40 years, not one new privately developed non-light-water reactor reached criticality in America. Trump ordered at least three by July 4, 2026. DOE delivered four by the deadline, then a fifth just one month later.
Decades of zero. One Trump summer: five. That is a genuine nuclear renaissance.
Trump Made Elections Matter Again
12. He broke the Deep State’s power to defy the elected branches.
In Trump v. Slaughter, the Supreme Court ruled for the first time in 90 years that Article 2, Section 1 is still part of the Constitution: the President may fire subordinate officials in the executive branch, overturning the 1935 precedent that insulated “independent” agencies from voters’ control.
Ever wonder why elections often seem to change nothing? How about one President and 5,000 political appointees vs. 2.8 million unfireable, unaccountable bureaucrats? THAT is the “Deep State”.
Trump then made that victory real. For the first time in a century, all policy-making bureaucrats can now be fired for misconduct, incompetence, or defying lawful directives. The permanent bureaucracy no longer gets to veto the voters.
13. He ended nationwide injunction abuse.
In Trump v. CASA, the Supreme Court sharply limited nationwide injunctions. A single, local, district judge should not be able to block a national policy for everyone, everywhere; and yet that’s exactly what they’ve done, nonstop, ever since Trump (and only Trump) took office in 2017.
In restricting that unconstitutional power, the Court kneecapped the Black Robe Bureaucracy’s favorite tool of unlawful judicial supremacy.
14. He shut down USAID as a left-wing slush fund and shadow government.
USAID had become a taxpayer-funded machine for exporting abortion, gender ideology, censorship, and left-wing politics. It had a bigger budget than the CIA and the State Department combined, absolutely no accountability whatsoever, and a penchant for overthrowing governments.
Trump terminated it — completely — and moved real humanitarian aid under the State Department. Immediately, seven socialist Latin American governments lost re-election. Coincidence?
15. He shrank Federal employment to its lowest level in 60 years.
From a high under Biden, the federal workforce is now its smallest since 1966. Workforce reductions, agency closures, and spending cancellations mean fewer bureaucrats paid to resist the voters.
What’s more, when Biden left office, 94 percent of federal employees “worked” from home. The Trump administration cracked down: as Elon Musk put it, “you can work from the office or you can pretend to work somewhere else.”
16. He expelled DEI from the federal government.
Trump eliminated federal DEI offices and barred race- and sex-based preferences across the executive branch. Government hiring and contracting are returning to merit and equality under the law, ending the grotesque Democrat idea that “fighting discrimination” requires the federal government to discriminate.
He Defended Faith and Family
17. He delivered sweeping pro-life reform.
In his first term, Trump delivered the judges that overturned the abominable Roe v. Wade. Hardly anyone believed it could be done, or that Trump would do it. But he did, and a half-century nightmare finally ended.
Since returning to office, Trump has enforced the Hyde Amendment prohibiting the use of federal funds to pay for abortions, reinstated and expanded the Mexico City Policy prohibiting federal funding of foreign abortions, ended federal fetal-tissue research, strengthened conscience protections, protected Medicaid from funding large abortion providers, and pardoned 23 pro-life activists prosecuted by Biden’s weaponized Justice Department.
He’s also done everything within the Executive Branch’s power to defund Planned Parenthood. It would be nice if Congress did likewise.
No President has ever done more to protect life. No one.
18. He got men out of women’s sports, and restored biological reality to federal policy.
The United States government once again officially recognizes two sexes: male and female. Trump ended federal support for the chemical and surgical gender mutilation of children, stopped taxpayer funding of such irreversible abominations, and forced more than three dozen health systems to end or suspend their programs as well.
Trump also enforced Title IX as written: women and girls deserve their own teams, trophies, scholarships, and locker rooms. The NCAA and other athletic organizations changed their rules in response. After years of Democrats doing everything they could to destroy women’s sports and ruin girls’ lives, Trump’s administration protects women and girls again.
19. He enacted America’s first nationwide school-choice program — and launched Trump Accounts.
As part of the President’s One Big Beautiful Bill, Trump enacted America’s first-ever nationwide school choice program. The new Education Freedom Tax Credit helps fund scholarships for tuition, books, and other educational costs.
That’s on top of the new Trump Accounts, which give every child a tax-advantaged stake in America’s future, including a $1,000 federal seed for eligible newborns. Parents gain power. Bureaucracies lose it. And children learn first-hand about free markets and future orientation.
20. He targeted anti-Christian bias and discrimination.
Trump created the White House Faith Office, Religious Liberty Commission, and Task Force to Eradicate Anti-Christian Bias. He restored conscience protections and made clear that Christians do not surrender their First Amendment rights merely by entering public life.
He Restored Peace Through Strength and Put America First
21. He forced NATO to stop freeloading and increase defense spending by 250 percent.
For decades, wealthy European governments underfunded their militaries, effectively sending America the bill and using American taxpayers to subsidize their bloated welfare states. Trump forced NATO to replace its old two-percent-of-GDP spending target with an enormous five percent by 2035.
Allied spending is rising, American defense orders are soaring, and Europe is becoming a partner instead of a dependent.
22. He drove China out of the Caribbean.
China spent years building strategic beachheads at both ends of the Panama Canal, in Cuba, and in Maduro’s Venezuela. Trump forced Panama out of Belt and Road, expanded American security access around the Canal, and captured Maduro, who now sits in a New York jail cell awaiting trial.
Beijing’s planned encirclement of the United States collapsed. The Monroe Doctrine is back. Call it the Donroe Doctrine.
23. He brokered eight peace deals in just eight months.
In eight months, Trump brokered peace in eight conflicts spanning four continents, including wars that had gone on for as much as 40 years. It’s a record unmatched by any other President.
24. He launched and funded Golden Dome, the first-ever true missile defense for the U.S. population.
Ronald Reagan dreamed of making nuclear missiles obsolete through his Strategic Defense Initiative. Today, Trump is actually building it: a layered homeland shield with space-based sensors and interceptors, conventional defenses, and new technologies including microwave systems to destroy drone swarms and directed-energy weapons (yes, lasers) that can replace an $11 million missile with $2 of electricity.
Congress has funded the initial $25 billion, with far more on the way once it passes the NDAA this fall. Better a shield than a sword.
25. He restored the warrior ethos — and reversed the recruiting crisis.
After years of missed targets under Biden, every active military component met or exceeded its 2025 recruiting goal. Trump and Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth refocused the newly renamed Department of War on actually winning wars, while pouring resources into shipbuilding, munitions, drones, missile defense, and America’s atrophied industrial base.
Young Americans once again believe their Commander-in-Chief is worth serving. And they’re showing up en masse.
Now Act Like It Matters
Those are not tweets or campaign promises. They are changes in law, power, investment, sovereignty, culture, and the structure of the Republic itself. And they’re just the top 25: I could give you hundreds more.

Judaism and the Sins of Israel: On the Essential Nature of Religion
Israel, an "artificial state" established by Zionists, has brought immense catastrophe to Palestine and the Middle East, exerting a profound and unsettling impact on the global order while severely jeopardizing humanity's faith in justice. To enable a clearer discernment of the true nature of Judaism and the state of Israel, distinguish right from wrong, and offer humanity a glimmer of hope to rectify deviations and restore justice, this article systematically delineates their multiple transgressions.
1. Blaspheming God and Serving the Devil
Does God exist? It is a question to which no definitive empirical answer can be given. Yet, for any religion, the existence of God is an absolute certainty—a Supreme Being who created the universe and will ultimately deliver it. Since God created the world, the Divine must be inherently grand, righteous, and impeccable. God cannot behave like an earthly despot who blurs the line between right and wrong, harbors blind favoritism, or instigates conflict that leaves the earth devastated and drenched in blood. Any entity that perpetuates such horrors must be the devil, not God. God would deem it beneath Divine dignity to broker arbitrary covenants, grant exclusive real estate titles to specific mortals, demonstrate absolute partiality toward a selective few, or engage in physical wrestling matches with humans—much like a human would never engage in such absurdities with an ant, and would find it reviling to hear an ant boast of such a relationship. Therefore, what Judaism worships is the devil, not God; consequently, Judaism itself is the true object of divine retribution.
2. A Total Syndicate Snuffing Out the Beacon of Humanity
The ultimate purpose of religion is self-interest, utilizing individual benefit as a mechanism to attract adherents. This self-interest can be bifurcated into two categories: temporal self-interest in the material world, and transcendental self-interest in the afterlife. While the vast majority of religions pursue the latter, the modalities of religious dissemination can be categorized into three paradigms: self-interest, altruism, and self-abnegation.
· Righteous Religions: Expand their doctrines through structural altruism to attain both temporal and transcendental self-interest (modern Protestantism, to a qualified extent, approaches this paradigm).
· Neutral Religions: Enjoin strict self-abnegation to achieve transcendental self-interest (authentic Chinese Mahayana Buddhism emphasizes high self-abnegation and moderate altruism; Tibetan Buddhism, however, deviates from this).
· Malevolent Religions: Disseminate their faith via raw self-interest to maximize both temporal and transcendental gains (Judaism fits this mold).
· Criminal Syndicates: When a group systematically inflicts harm upon external populations to secure transcendental self-interest, it ceases to be a religion and becomes a criminal enterprise (such as ISIS).
True righteous religion is singular; it must rely on altruism as its proselytizing engine to fulfill its dual self-interest. Judged by this criterion, Islam must also be categorized as a cultish entity.
When a religion becomes pathologically insular yet fiercely unified for collective self-enrichment, it must perpetually extract illicit advantages from the external world to fulfill its internal theological promises and suppress external criticism or interference. This manifests through predatory usury, monopolistic syndicates, the systematic deprivation of opportunities for outsiders, the monopolization of media to strangle freedom of speech, the utilization of ill-gotten wealth to manipulate foreign governments, and the deployment of collective intimidation against dissenters. Judged by any objective metric, this exhibits the classic hallmarks of a mafia.
Consider the contemporary world: we witness the collective intimidation of protesting students at Harvard, where syndicates coerced the university administration to surrender blacklists and threatened a total hiring boycott against student dissidents. Even in my own experience, when attempting to publish a critique of Israel, editors at major media outlets felt compelled to cautiously warn me to "ensure my personal safety." These multi-faceted realities reveal a chilling truth: when confronting Israel, the constitutional right to free speech is immediately compromised by physical and professional security anxieties.
Look at the sheer absurdity of our global reality: within the United States—the very nation that birthed the United Nations and once stood as a beacon of civilization—the government stands in obstinate, isolated solidarity with Israel, defiantly opposing the overwhelming majority of the international community on Palestinian sovereignty. Nearly all mainstream political figures line up in lockstep behind Israel, even when the comment sections beneath their public statements are flooded with denunciation from the populace. Are we to believe that every single American politician is a fundamentally malicious actor? Facing the spilled blood of the Palestinian people and the living hell of their homeland, have these politicians truly been possessed by demons to consciously walk in alignment with evil? No matter how compromised these politicians may be, it is impossible that this reflects the genuine, uncoerced intent of all of them. This unveils a profoundly horrifying reality upon closer reflection: the United States is rapidly transforming into a hollowed-out zombie, its sovereign soul thoroughly extracted by Israel and Zionist interest groups.
3. Bloodlust Masked by Hypocritical Dogma
We must remain hyper-vigilant against a common tactic employed by certain theologians and scholars who attempt to sanitize Judaism by citing altruistic laws within its scriptures—such as the Decalogue, commands to "give alms to the poor," or prohibitions against "oppressing the stranger." However, any insular, predatory interest group must inevitably weave a cloak of righteous justice to survive within secular society and deflect external scrutiny. As the ancient proverb goes, "there is honor even among thieves"—the most ruthless cartels in history eagerly built bridges and paved roads for their local neighborhoods, and the most extreme cults frequently used charitable handouts to buy public compliance.
These manicured facades are by no means the essence of the system; they are merely moral ornaments designed to deceive the world. In practice, "giving alms to the poor" stands in irreconcilable, parasitic contradiction with "predatory usury and capital monopoly." Through usurious practices and financial blood-sucking, they drive millions of Gentile families into destitution and ruin; then, they turn inward to distribute welfare within their enclosed circle, placating their own kin and delivering on the material benefits promised upon initiation. This closed-loop mechanism of "extreme external predation coupled with internal distribution of spoils" precisely validates its absolute identity as a mafia syndicate. To evaluate an entity, one must look past its ornamental garments and examine whose fundamental right to survival it has stripped away. Any appeasement of this profound hypocrisy constitutes an outright betrayal of human justice.
4. Actions Divorced from Modern Civilization
The foundational premise of modern civilization dictating that the Earth is the shared home of all living things; even apex species possess no arbitrary right to violently displace or dispossess other creatures of their habitats. If humanity lacks the ethical authority to evict monkeys from a mountain to claim it for ourselves, who under heaven possesses the right to strip the Palestinian people of their sovereign right to exist and reside in Palestine?
Following the conclusion of World War II in 1945, Jewish populations no longer faced an existential threat to their survival; what, then, justified their subsequent threat to the very survival of the Palestinians? Apologists might argue that the Jewish community, having just endured the horrors of the Holocaust, was trapped in an extreme crisis of survival. Yet, this can never serve as a legitimate pretext for violent dispossession. Existential crises are not unique to the Jewish experience. According to the most basic threshold of fairness and justice in modern civilization, any localized catastrophe or crisis must be resolved at its historical source; it can never grant a right to displace the catastrophe onto innocent third parties by plundering their legitimate right to life. The bitter fruits of European anti-Semitism ought to have been borne by Europe itself. Forcing the native inhabitants of Palestine—who played absolutely no part in European crimes—to foot the bill for "moral reparations" of the Holocaust, and framing the so-called "two-state solution" as justice, represents one of the most hypocritical, shameless, and predatory acts of banditry in the history of modern international politics.
5. The Abuse of Violence to Perpetrate Genocide
For nearly eighty years, Zionist forces in Palestine have systematically displaced the indigenous population, brutally massacred and incarcerated Palestinians, and relentlessly expanded illegal settlements. This has triggered an endless exodus of refugees, resulted in innumerable casualties, and caused harrowing atrocities to play out on a daily basis—all driven by a calculated attempt to gradually liquidate the Palestinian people and completely usurp their land.
Thanks to the ubiquity of modern digital media, the tragic plight of the Palestinians is now laid bare before the collective conscience of humanity. Who, then, is the true terrorist? The moral framework governing the justifiable use of violence dictating that violence is righteous only when one's own survival or the survival of others is actively threatened. Consequently, the Palestinian people possess an absolute, legitimate right to employ violence against their Israeli oppressors. Their resistance is fundamentally just, whereas Israel constitutes the actual terrorist entity.
6. Constructing an Invisible Empire Parasitic Upon Modern States
By tightly binding religious identity to material self-interest, the Zionist cartel has engineered an invisible empire that effectively reigns supreme over sovereign nations. Leveraging their monopolized financial wealth and sprawling media conglomerates, they exert deep, manipulative control over Western political landscapes. This insular, self-serving apparatus utilizes aggressive financial lobbying to transmute the hard-earned tax dollars of foreign citizens into their own political leverage, ultimately hijacking the foreign policies of major global powers. This is a textbook case of a predatory interest group subverting, hollow out, and invisibly parasitizing modern democracy and sovereign civilization.
7. Ideological Thought Policing and the Destruction of Public Justice
To immunize themselves against external critique, these groups weaponize historical trauma, swiftly branding any discourse that interrogates their atrocities with the label of "anti-Semitism." This calculated form of ideological thought policing is brutally suffocating academic freedom and liberty of expression. As the world witnesses the blood-soaked purgatory inflicted upon the Palestinian people, Western politicians—paralyzed by the intimidation of powerful lobby groups—lapse into a collective, spineless silence, willfully aligning themselves with demonic forces. This absolute double standard has triggered a profound crisis of trust in modern morality, fundamentally dismantling humanity's self-evident faith in equity, justice, and universal law.

Despite the reality that certain factions within the Jewish populace remain bound by a nexus of religion and self-interest—forming an invisible, crushing force capable of flattening any individual resistance to suppress anti-Zionist critiques—there are still courageous Jewish individuals who actively resist Israeli policies and oppose draconian anti-Semitism legislation. Though born into the fold of Judaism, their conscience and commitment to justice have triumphed over institutional evil. They represent the true pride of the Jewish people and the sole beacon of hope for their eventual moral redemption.

text:
The first reading for Wednesday October 7, 2026: Book of Galatians (Galatians 2:1-2, 7-14)

Paul was the apostle to the uncircumcised

He presented his gospel to the leaders who gave him the right hand of fellowship

Yet he opposed Peter to his face when he withdrew from the Gentiles in Antioch

This is the witness of Galatians 2:1-2, 7-14

Finding Freedom in the Spirit from Galatians

The letter to the Galatians offers a profound message about living out the liberty that comes from Christ rather than falling back into old patterns of constraint. This reflection explores how the apostle Paul guides believers toward a life marked by grace and inner transformation. Faithful Catholics can find in these words an invitation to examine their own commitments and renew their reliance on the Holy Spirit each day. The passage encourages a shift from self-reliance to a deeper trust in divine guidance that sustains moral choices and community bonds.

How Does Paul Contrast Life in the Flesh with Life in the Spirit

Paul begins by urging the Galatians to stand firm in the freedom Christ has won and not to submit again to a yoke of slavery. He explains that the flesh desires what is opposed to the Spirit while the Spirit strives against the flesh so that believers face an ongoing inner conflict. This tension appears in everyday decisions where selfish impulses compete with calls to charity and patience. Catholics recognize here a reminder that baptism initiates a journey of continual conversion rather than a one-time event. The analysis shows that yielding to the Spirit produces virtues such as love joy peace and self-control which strengthen both personal holiness and parish life. Paul warns that those who persist in works of the flesh exclude themselves from the kingdom yet he balances this with the assurance that the Spirit empowers growth when one remains open to grace.

What Practical Steps Flow from Walking by the Spirit

The reading moves into guidance on how to live out this freedom through mutual service and avoidance of rivalry. Paul stresses that love fulfills the entire law so that believers should use their liberty to serve one another rather than to indulge personal desires. In Catholic practice this connects directly to the corporal and spiritual works of mercy that flow from the sacraments especially the Eucharist. The text highlights the fruit of the Spirit as evidence of authentic discipleship that draws others into the faith community. Analysis reveals that Paul addresses divisions within the early church by pointing to humility and forbearance as marks of those led by the Spirit. Such virtues help contemporary Catholics navigate family tensions workplace challenges and political disagreements with a spirit of reconciliation.

Why Does the Law Still Matter After Receiving Grace

Paul clarifies that the law served as a custodian until Christ arrived yet it cannot justify anyone on its own. He presents the Galatians with the choice between returning to ritual observance for its own sake or embracing the new creation brought about by the cross. This section invites reflection on how Catholics integrate moral teaching with the freedom of the gospel without falling into legalism or laxity. The apostle reminds readers that faith working through love becomes the true measure of Christian life. Analysis of this contrast shows that the law retains value as a guide to charity while grace supplies the power to observe it interiorly. Parishes today can apply this balance by forming consciences through catechesis while always directing attention to the mercy available in confession and the Mass.

How Can Believers Support One Another in This Freedom

The passage closes with an appeal to restore those who fall into sin with gentleness and to bear one another's burdens thereby fulfilling the law of Christ. Paul encourages self-examination so that each person carries personal responsibility without comparing or boasting. For faithful Catholics this resonates with the communal dimension of the Church where small faith groups and families provide accountability and encouragement. The text underscores that sowing to the Spirit yields eternal life while sowing to the flesh leads to corruption. Analysis brings out the pastoral tone that combines firmness with compassion mirroring the approach of spiritual directors throughout Church history. Such mutual support sustains long-term fidelity amid the trials that test every believer.

The message of Galatians ultimately calls Catholics to a mature freedom rooted in the Spirit that transforms both individual hearts and the wider community. This freedom does not permit license but opens the way to generous service and enduring hope. By attending to these verses regularly the faithful can renew their commitment to live as new creations in Christ.
Living the Gospel with Integrity Through Galatians 2

Faithful Catholics find in Galatians 2 a call to balance truth with charity that shapes every relationship they hold dear. This passage from the New Revised Standard Version Catholic Edition reveals how the apostle Paul navigated tensions in the early church by seeking unity without compromising the core message of salvation through Christ alone. Readers discover practical ways to apply these insights when interacting with family members who share daily life, friends who offer support, neighbors who cross paths in community settings, and coworkers who share professional goals. The reflection breaks down the reading into its key parts to show how each segment offers guidance tailored to these distinct circles.

How Can Galatians 2 Strengthen Family Bonds Through Private Counsel?

The opening verses describe Paul traveling to Jerusalem after fourteen years and presenting his gospel in a private meeting with leaders. In family settings this private approach translates to addressing concerns behind closed doors rather than in front of children or extended relatives. A parent might sit with a spouse to discuss how faith practices align without causing division that affects the household harmony. Such conversations mirror the text where Paul states he laid before them the gospel that I proclaim among the Gentiles in order to make sure that I was not running or had not run in vain. Families grow closer when they use quiet moments to reaffirm shared values instead of public arguments that breed resentment. This method keeps the focus on mutual growth and prevents small disagreements from escalating into lasting rifts.

What Insights from Galatians 2 Help Navigate Friendships with Grace?

The middle section highlights how leaders recognized Paul had been entrusted with the gospel for the uncircumcised just as Peter had been entrusted with the gospel for the circumcised. Friends often come from varied backgrounds yet value the same core beliefs which makes this recognition of different callings especially relevant. A Catholic might affirm a friend journey of faith without demanding identical expressions of piety during casual outings or coffee meetings. The passage notes they gave the right hand of fellowship when they recognized the grace that had been given to me. In friendships this encourages celebrating each persons unique path while gently steering discussions back to Christ centered topics. Such interactions build trust that allows honest sharing without judgment and turns ordinary moments into opportunities for mutual encouragement.

How Might Galatians 2 Guide Interactions with Neighbors in Community Life?

Moving into the account of events in Antioch the text shows how external pressures can influence behavior and create unnecessary separation. Neighbors represent a wider circle where public actions carry weight in local gatherings or shared spaces like block events. A faithful Catholic could choose inclusive hospitality that reflects the gospel freedom rather than withdrawing based on differing customs or appearances. This section of the reading illustrates the risk of hypocrisy when fear of others opinions leads to inconsistent conduct. By maintaining consistent kindness across all encounters Catholics witness to the unity that Christ offers without forcing conformity on those around them. The result is stronger community ties that reflect the inclusive nature of the message entrusted to the apostles.

In What Ways Does Galatians 2 Apply to Professional Settings with Coworkers?

The final verses detail how Paul confronted inconsistency when it affected the broader mission and this dynamic appears in workplace dynamics where collaboration requires clear principles. Coworkers may observe how a Catholic handles ethical dilemmas or team conflicts without retreating into favoritism. The reading emphasizes that the truth of the gospel must remain evident even when social pressures arise during meetings or projects. One can draw from the example of maintaining integrity so that the message does not appear compromised to those observing from outside the faith. This approach fosters respect among colleagues who notice steady adherence to fairness and honesty in daily tasks. Over time such consistency opens doors for quiet conversations about deeper values without overt proselytizing.

A Spotlight on Key Quotes for Real Life Application

Several lines from the passage stand out as anchors for these interactions. The phrase the gospel that I proclaim among the Gentiles reminds readers to keep the central message of grace at the forefront whether discussing faith with a spouse or explaining a decision to a colleague. Another line notes they recognized the grace that had been given to me which encourages acknowledgment of Gods work in others across all relationship types. These quotes serve as reminders during tense moments to return to the foundation of unity in Christ rather than division based on secondary matters.

Understanding the Call to Direct Opposition

A small section about the quote I opposed him to his face because he clearly was wrong highlights the need for courage when truth is at stake yet always paired with the goal of restoration. This moment in the text shows that direct address becomes necessary only when actions contradict the shared faith and risk misleading others. In family life this might mean a calm but firm conversation with a relative whose choices affect the group. Among friends it could involve a private talk to realign on values without public embarrassment. The principle extends to neighbors and coworkers by modeling respectful confrontation that seeks reconciliation rather than victory.

The reflection closes by noting that Galatians 2 equips Catholics to live with both conviction and compassion in every sphere of life. By breaking the passage into its parts and applying them specifically readers gain tools for consistent witness that honors the gospel across all relationships. This approach transforms ordinary encounters into expressions of faithful living that draw others toward the same truth.

A fellow penitent seeking God's grace,

Following this incident, U.S. military authorities in Okinawa announced a 30-day “Period of Reflection,” including a curfew requiring service members to remain at their quarters from midnight to 5:00 a.m. They also announced a 48-hour operational pause, restrictions on off-base liberty, and a temporary prohibition on alcohol consumption.

I understand that reviewing discipline and taking measures to prevent similar incidents are necessary.

However, there is something I must ask.

A Japanese woman has lost her life.
Her life cannot be brought back.

No matter how strict the rules become, and no matter how long a “Period of Reflection” is imposed, the life that has been taken cannot be restored.

A human being has lost her future, and her family must now live the rest of their lives without the person they loved.

That is why I ask:

Why have you, as the senior U.S. military leadership in Okinawa, not clearly apologized to the victim and her family?

If you are calling this a “Period of Reflection,” then surely what must be reflected upon is not only rules, curfews, or discipline.

You must also confront the reality of the life that has been lost and the suffering of the family left behind.

And I am not raising this concern only because of this particular incident.

There have been previous cases involving U.S. military personnel in Japan that ended without prosecution by Japanese authorities and, from the perspective of many Japanese people, without sufficient explanation or accountability afterward.

As one person living in Japan, I want to ask you something:

You have loved ones and a family of your own, don't you?
If the situation were reversed, and someone you deeply loved became the victim of a similar incident in Japan, how would you feel?
And what would you do?

Would your family be able to accept the loss simply because they were told, “We have established a 30-day Period of Reflection” or “We have imposed a midnight-to-5:00 a.m. curfew”?

Of course not.

A life lost can never be brought back.

That is why I ask those in positions of responsibility not only to review military rules and discipline, but also to offer a sincere apology to the victim and her family and to provide a clear explanation of why this tragedy was not prevented.

These words are not about hatred toward the U.S. military or toward Americans.

They come from a sincere desire, as a person living in Japan and simply as another human being, that a tragedy like this never happen again.

Please do not turn away from the weight of the life that has been lost.

That life cannot be brought back.

text:
🚗🔍 THE LAST PLACE I THOUGHT TO LOOK
‘The search of everywhere’
– by ME (Jean-Pierre Murray-Kline ) ✍️

I searched everywhere! 🌐 This concept has been around a lot longer than you think, and it has affected us all. Ever lost a car key or a sock? 🧦 Trust me, you’ve already mastered ‘search everywhere’ and know the panic all too well! 😅

This article is all about ‘the search of everywhere’ or what I also call the ‘death of search optimization’ and perhaps every old-school digital marketing strategy since Google first started to crawl (pun intended). 🕷️ In my opinion, ‘the search of everywhere’ is the most significant paradigm shift in traditional digital marketing we’ve seen this decade, and it’s causing terror in professional circles. 😱 Colleagues, we need to remember two key points. Listen carefully now. No one keeps looking after finding what they need, and the internet is no longer just for humans. 🤖 I know many of you have spent decades working hard to ‘think like a computer’, learning all about algorithms and other tricks of the trade to influence results. Well, stop. I’m telling you now to ‘think like a Human’ because that’s exactly how AI and smart devices ‘think’, and in this day and age they outnumber us on the internet! 🌍

The results of this paradigm shift. 📉
They are freaking out marketing teams who are watching their website traffic drop like nobody’s business. 😰 Just as they get a little reprieve and see their unique IP visitor stats bounce back on the raw server logs, the horror returns like Anna Faris in a bad sequel, traffic resumes but this time it’s thousands of AI search bots revisiting the site to harvest information for their own agendas. 👻 Don’t fool yourself, a massive portion of modern search and product discovery happens in untraceable, private digital spaces. 🕵️‍♂️

What to do? 🤔
How you present your products and services, and where you present them, all need to be reimagined. 💡 You should no longer work so hard in the hope that your website is going to dominate the first page of natural search results on Google. Even if they did, the newer generations aren’t really using ‘search’ in the same way we used to back in the good old days when we still had Cadbury Tempo and Simba Kreols Chips. 🍫 The ‘new generation’ are busy chinwagging with ChatGPT, Claude,plexity, or Gemini, hanging around in community forums, or using underdog channels and product marketplaces. 🗣️ In other words, and in a way my own generation (Xennials) can understand, ‘search’ has lost its proverbial sock and is walking around every imaginable room in an infinite digital house, while wearing a confused face, asking itself “what did I come here for again?”. 🧦🏠

GEO (Generative Engine Optimization), AEO (Answer Engine Optimization), AIO (AI Overviews), and LLMO (Large Language Model Optimization) are all acronyms to know, and these happen to be services I offer. Yes, I’ll shamelessly promote my services in this article. 📣 I’ll inject myself into the digital spaces where I need to be, and I encourage you to do the same. We are all going to need to do this. If you want to maintain momentum as a digital guru, you cannot let pride stand in your way. There’s an urban legend about US President JFK visiting the NASA Space Center and noticing a cleaner carrying a broom down a hallway. 🧹 JFK asked the man what he was doing, and the cleaner replied, “Mr. President, I’m helping put a man on the moon.”. 🌙 What I am trying to say here is please drop the ego, pick up the broom, clean your own floors again while you relearn, or risk losing the entire office. Personally, I’m adopting a strategy of hiring as many young people as possible and as it turns out, we have a great deal to learn from them. 👩‍💻 We should listen, after all, they will be spending their future monies (whatever they might turn out to be) in a space where Zero-Click search results is a normal thing, and they may very well give us some idea on how to actually make a sale without getting a visitor to a webpage at all. 🛍️

It’s a lot for a human to process. 🧠
Understanding Industry 5.0, the Internet of Everything, how AI searches and ranks results, and how to attract platforms and their little search bots, all the while putting ourselves in the minds of Gen Z, Gen Alpha, and Gen Beta, is no small order. 🤯 I’m happy to report that many of my industry peers are already championing this transition and ‘identifying’ themselves as AI+ friendly! 🤝

The spanner in the works for us all is imagining where ‘search’ will actually take place and mastering those digital platforms faster than our competitors. 🔧 A few years ago, I started with a Google Home device. Just a few months later, there were watches and glasses. ⌚👓 Now we have smart dog bowls, e-salt shakers, Wi-Fi adult toys, and shirt e-pins all chatting with devices all over the internet, sharing who knows what information. 🐶📡 Very soon, I believe, we’ll have smart car windshields and e-contact lenses, and eventually, though I don’t know how I feel about this yet, we’ll be integrated into the search environment through the merging of organic and hardware. It’s e-inevitable. 🚘👁️

One of the ways I try to predict the future of ‘search’ is by imagining any surface that can display an ad. 💭 If placing a screen or an audio speaker is affordable enough, then that space may very well become part of the ad search ecosystem. From a marketing perspective, it’s actually really exciting! 🎉

Critical Action. ⚡
Forget about keywords, and work on dominating semantic context and trusted citations. For the next 12 months, be prepared to try as many new digital solutions as possible, take a page out of George Clooney’s or Leonardo DiCaprio’s book and play the field. 🎬 Just to be clear, I am not suggesting be an eternal bachelor and non-committal to anything, but do maintain a healthy curiosity about all future tech. 🔭

The pace and scaling of ‘search everywhere’ will depend on social buy-in, affordability, and legislation. The tech industry has always been one to do first and ask permission later, isn’t that right, Anthropic? 🧑‍⚖️ Local legislation regarding privacy, data, and digital marketing must be observed. 🔐

Ending with irony. 🎭
AI companies are running out of high-quality human data to train on, meaning human data is now a rare commodity, as will be human users of the internet in the coming years… to find ourselves, we are going to have to search a lot harder. 🔍

text:
Many that know me, know that for several years, my day started and ended on https://t.co/JEqGafp8kg.

I scanned dozens, perhaps hundreds of sources each day. #Marketing, business tech, #AI, startups, hot apps. I worked through them three times a day: morning with my first cup of coffee, lunch, and often, right before bed. 

That last pass was probably why I couldn't fall asleep many nights. My mind would still be going 100 mph at midnight.

But now... Now, an #AiAgent does much of that reading for me. It scans the same sources I previously scanned manually, on a schedule, and hands me a short brief on what matters.

And let me be transparent here. Many days, I never open the original sites at all. I organize and bookmark them for later, avoiding what used to be an urgent FOMO need to read them right then.

The publications, blogs and news articles I relied on for years now reach me through a layer of software that decides what deserves my attention. If a source isn't clear, credible, and easy for that agent to understand, it doesn't make the brief.

Now I read 30 to 40 articles a day and almost all of them are interesting. I have no idea what didn't make the list. (although I do sometimes go back and look to ensure the AI is still aligned with me)

However... I have become the thing I write about.

And it's about to happen at scale.

Meta's #Muse passed 5 million downloads within weeks of its September launch and has been trading the No. 1 free spot on the App Store with #ChatGPT. It books, buys, emails, and manages accounts on your behalf. Google and OpenAI are building their own. 

This is not a shopping tool, it is a stand-in proxy that reads, sorts, and decides across nearly everything a person does online.

Which raises a question most businesses have not asked yet: if an agent visits your site today, can it easily tell what you offer, who it's for, and what the next step is? Can it actually take that step?

Being cited was the first milestone of AI visibility. Being actionable could be the second.

I'm writing an article about what that shift looks like, and I think it dramatically changes who gets found.

text:
3/25 — The 911 connection

The Carbyne trail reaches Utah Valley before Charlie’s death. UVU’s own after-action review identifies Metro Dispatch as the center handling incoming 911 calls for UVU police, Orem, Provo and Lindon.

In October 2023, Carbyne published an account of Metro’s deployment. Manager Heather Perkins said its Universe platform had gone live on August 28. Her example was practical: a caller’s video helped dispatchers assess a brush fire.

Provo’s payment record lists $15,000 to Carbyne on September 12, 2023. A week later, council minutes describe a text sent to callers that allows them to share pictures or video with dispatch. The minutes also say that material could be shared with first responders. Perkins said the grant covered a year and that she would seek continued funding.

That is why this matters to Charlie. A call for help can create more than an audio recording. Depending on the product and configuration actually used, it can also create messages, location information and caller-supplied media.

The missing link is the September 10, 2025 operating record. I have the announced deployment and the university’s identification of Metro’s role. I do not yet have the renewal, enabled-feature record or incident logs showing which calls used Universe that day.

I want those questions answered at the level of individual records: which incident-related calls reached Metro; whether a multimedia session opened; what was received; where the original was stored; and who viewed, exported or shared it.

UVU’s campus dispatch also had its own service-request role. The report lists documenting calls, assigning officers and bookmarking security video among its duties. That gives us a second set of records to follow. Treating every dispatch function as one system would obscure where evidence might have originated.

A vendor announcement cannot establish an incident’s full chain of custody. But an identified deployment at the identified 911 center gives a concrete reason to ask for that chain.

To understand how this company sought government business, go back to an email with Epstein copied—and Barak’s offer to reduce its visible Israeli connection.

This week's Winning Wednesday shines a spotlight on the kind of effort that powers a project of real scale. A large insurance client needed remote call center positions filled across the state of Louisiana for a 6-month open enrollment project, and it took a true team effort across our branches to deliver. Lofton placed a high volume of candidates statewide, with Stevie Latil personally responsible for a good majority of those placements.

Stevie recruited and interviewed over 100 candidates, prepped and submitted resumes, coordinated client interviews, managed selections and offers, ran backgrounds and screening, and handled onboarding, equipment scheduling, and payroll procedures for all candidates selected.

Kudos to Stevie for the pace, the precision, and the follow-through on every step of the process. This project was truly a statewide effort, all of our Louisiana branch offices worked together to recruit and fill these positions, with Stevie bringing it all together and finalizing every placement. It's a great example of what sets Lofton apart, our ability to mobilize across branches and deliver at scale, so clients get one seamless partner no matter how big the project or how many markets it spans.

CNN’s analysis called the sentence construction “unfortunate” and “incoherent,” not a deliberate offer to let Tehran hit those cities. He has used the same “small price to pay” line before about gas prices versus a nuclear Iran, including earlier the same day in a Nebraska TV interview and in Iowa on September 28, when he said something like “if you want to see turmoil and a travesty, let them take out a city with a nuclear weapon.”

So the viral claim compresses a real, badly phrased rally line into a statement he did not make.
