text:
BUYERS TOOK $39B OF 10-YEAR NOTES BELOW THE MARKET'S RATE. HOMEBUILDERS ARE STILL DOWN 3%:

The bond market's biggest test of the day came back strong. Washington's $39B sale of 10-year notes went at a rate a hair under where those notes traded when bidding closed at 1pm ET, and the yield has slid since. The verdict at 1pm: the borrowing-cost scare that drove the morning is fading in bonds faster than in the stocks it hit. Small companies, homebuilders and machinery makers have won back far less, and the Federal Reserve's minutes at 2pm are the next test of that gap.

The sale, by the Treasury's own results at 1:04pm ET:

- Sold: $39B of 10-year notes at 5.300%.
- Bids: $2.77 for every $1 on offer, vs $2.71 at September's sale of the same note.
- Left to dealers: 2.5%, vs 4.3% in September.

Dealers are the big banks required to bid at every sale, and they keep whatever nobody else wants. This time they kept almost nothing. Indirect bidders, a group that includes foreign central banks placing bids through those dealers, took 80%.

Yields at 1:08pm ET:

- 10-year: 5.277%, +0.006 percentage point / +0.11% from Tuesday's 5.271% close.
- 30-year: 5.659%, +0.018 percentage point / +0.32% from Tuesday's 5.641% close.
- 2-year: 4.781%, -0.010 percentage point / -0.21% from Tuesday's 4.791% close.

Near the 9:30am open, the 10-year touched 5.365%, above every daily close after April 2, 2002, by the Federal Reserve's count. It has since given back nearly all of the day's rise. The 2-year, which follows what traders expect the Fed to do with short-term rates, barely moved: the whole climb and retreat happened in long-term lending.

Stocks at 1:08pm ET:

- S&P 500: 7,798.13, -20.80 points / -0.27%.
- Dow Jones Industrial Average: 51,189.10, -332.18 points / -0.64%.
- Nasdaq-100: 31,121.02, -103.67 points / -0.33%.
- SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust $SPY at $777.06, -$2.03 / -0.26% today.

The S&P 500 bottomed at 7,763.34 around 10:45am and is back at its high of the session. The groups that sold on borrowing costs have followed only part of the way:

- Small companies: iShares Russell 2000 ETF (IWM) at $278.28, -$3.06 / -1.09% today.
- Homebuilders: iShares U.S. Home Construction ETF (ITB) at $84.37, -$2.59 / -2.97% today.
- Industrial companies: Industrial Select Sector SPDR Fund (XLI) at $168.27, -$3.31 / -1.93% today.

These funds are baskets of stocks, so no Len5 applies to them. The homebuilder fund touched $83.91 today, its lowest price in a year, and has barely climbed off it. Mortgage rates follow the 10-year, and Freddie Mac's 30-year rate was already 7.28% on October 1. Small companies lean harder on borrowed money than big ones do.

The heaviest single blow:

Caterpillar (CAT) at $815.09, -$48.35 / -5.60% today.

That is about $22B of market value. Heavy equipment is usually bought on credit, so a jump in borrowing costs lands on the demand Caterpillar sells into. Caterpillar is on none of the six Len5es: at about 37 times its past year of profit, the discount the value styles wait for is missing.

Health care is the offset:

- Health Care Select Sector SPDR Fund (XLV) at $169.94, +$2.85 / +1.71% today.

Drugmakers and health insurers are both rising, and their customers do not need a loan to buy.

The morning's second pressure, fuel, has faded too. Against Tuesday's settlement prices, the official daily closes, near 1pm ET:

- Diesel futures (November): $4.62 a gallon, +5.3 cents / +1.17%.
- WTI crude, the US benchmark (November): $88.76 a barrel, -$0.68 / -0.76%.
- Brent crude, the global benchmark (December): $100.72 a barrel, +$0.14 / +0.14%.

Diesel touched $4.76 near the 9:30am open. Two reports since then point the other way. At 10:30am, the Energy Information Administration's weekly count for the week ended October 2 showed diesel and heating oil stocks flat at 105.1M barrels, where analysts expected a drop. By the National Hurricane Center's 11am advisory, the hurricane watch for Tropical Storm Isaias ran from Bay St. Louis, Mississippi, to Indian Pass, Florida, east of Louisiana's refineries.

Into the close and beyond, Eastern time:

- 2pm: minutes of the Fed's September 15-16 meeting, where it raised its key rate to a 3.75%-4.00% range, its first increase since 2023. Read them for how many officials wanted to keep going, and how much weight they put on energy prices.
- 4pm: the close. Monday's 5.311% was the 10-year's highest close since May 2002, and it sits below that now.
- 5pm: the hurricane center's next full advisory. Isaias is forecast to become a hurricane Thursday and reach the northern Gulf Coast Friday.
- Thursday, noon: Freddie Mac's weekly mortgage rate.
- Thursday, 1pm: the Treasury sells $22B of 30-year bonds.
- Wednesday, October 14, 8:30am: the Bureau of Labor Statistics' consumer price index for September.

What would change this read:

- The 10-year back above Monday's 5.311% after the minutes.
- Small companies still sliding with the 10-year flat, a sign the selling is about profits, not rates.
- The 5pm advisory moving the hurricane watch west toward Louisiana.

The bond market found its buyers at 5.30% and let go of the morning's scare. Homebuilders and machinery makers are still holding on to it. The key risk sits at 2pm: minutes that read like a Fed ready to raise again would send the 10-year back up just after it relaxed.

text:
Total frigging naked honesty. What is actually in one day of an ordinary human life? 
I first woke up at 2 am. Had a dream where I am waiting at some school for my son with other parents. I don’t have pants and I can’t control my bowels and some parents see this. I am deeply ashamed. They are also angry with me. At the same time they offer help. They give me tissues to clean myself. To my even bigger shock they take these tissues in their hands to dispose of them. A little bit later I talk to my uncle Maurice and say that I really think there is something wrong with me. I only half believe that, am saying this as an excuse for having lost control of my bowels. I turn to chatgpt for an explanation and it says: ‘You are very active in the public eye. You realize you could make a fool of yourself, but curiously you think you may anger people, but also that they will not drop you, they will help you. You will feel shame though if it happens.’ I accept that answer and go back to bed. I wake up at 4 am. This time I decide to get up. I write some post on similarities between Gettysburg and the strategic situation on October 7th. I write some post about how easily the US bombing a school is forgotten the media, but not local crime. All the while am listening to an interview with an expert on Iran. I also buy six audiobooks, 4 of them on Palestine/Israel, one on the American Civil War which is set to be released next week, one on contemporary society. Later today I share the whole audible account with a friend, Anna, in Belgium. At 6.30 am I teach a class of Dutch. At 9.00 I teach a 90 minute class of conversational English. I send out a few tweets. Doesn’t count as work in my head at all. I don’t know what I’d call it. Productive madness. 
 
At 11.00 I have to see an educator at my son’s school, because he’s noticed that my son is unhappy because me and his mum don’t live together. The educator starts – oddly – pumping me and Bruno’s mum for advice on how to deal with a tough class. Am right now not entirely sure if he wanted to see us because of Bruno or because he wanted to impress us with how hard he is trying to make things work with a particularly challenging class. Most of all I learn that my son is in a tough group with lots of kids who are struggling, one is even actively being abused at home… What the hell. I already knew this based on descriptions of the boy by my son, but weird to have it so plainly confirmed by this educator. 
 
After this I go to a class at one company. A German-English class. Meaning some of the class takes place in English and some takes place in German. Two for the price of one, let’s say. It’s a student I love dearly and he is one of the main reasons why I am still teaching, even though economically coaching and therapy sessions make way more sense. He’s a funny Czech guy who is much more down to earth that overthinking, overly sensitive, overly permeable, ever pondering me. Hey, even my last name means ‘ponderer’. Nomen est omen. 
 
From this company I take the bus home for another class. Conversational English. 
 
After that conversational German, which if am being accurate is much more like psychotherapy in German, a statement the student would immediately agree with. I do not see it as real psychotherapy, since at first I was only his German teacher, but the effects have been the same. He’s told his boss he no longer needs German lessons, but that he wants to keep our conversations. 
 
Is this now a complete account of my day? 
 
No, I was also in touch with an Israeli, even though I spent quite a few free moments today attacking the nation I see as the uncontested champion in creating amputee kids and other vile acts. And I find it truly disgusting how October 7th is of course being milked in traditional fashion. Genocidal nutcases eagerly sharing ‘hot’ dead Israeli women – usually with IDF membership, so not exactly innocent little angels who happen to show cleavage in all their pictures. You can guess they are not sharing these pictures because they are sincerely mourning these women, often female soldiers in a lunatic organization, but they’re doing this to get likes from their little tribe/weird pornified death cult or to get sympathy for their genocidal urges or simply because they get some kick out of it. Maybe some are doing post-mortem simping and hope to revive these IDF babes if they sing their praises pathetically enough. 
 
In a break I fraternized with the enemy some more. It’s of course destabilizing and yet hopeful to find someone in the enemy camp who doesn’t try to humiliate you with the typical ‘moron’ retard’ ‘idiot’ barrage. I wish that at least for varation they’d throw in ‘troglodyte’  or ‘nincompoop’ occasionally, but anyone who calls other people ‘retard’ happens to have hatred stored where other people store vocabulary. 
 
Now do tell if this strikes you as a fairly complete account of one day in the life of William the utterly ordinary in an utterly ordinary neck of the woods on – except for people who actually spot when some events have enormous repurcussions for all of humanity – a totally ordinary day.

text:
Analyzing Episode 66. Season 3 aka Everyone Pays

You know that scene in ep66 where Ciho says, 'Bedel ver?' Yeah, that's what this episode represented to me. Take what you will, says God, but pay for it - as the saying goes. Actions have reactions, folks. That's basic science. 

Anyway, let's jump straight into the fray of ep67. We kick off the episode with Alya being detained at the airport because Deniz Escobar was a little loose with hiding the stash. 

When the cops ask Alya if she has any family in Turkey, she relives one of the bitterest truths of her life. 

She has no one but her son. She had Cihan once, but she lost him due to her mistakes (or so Ciho wants her to think), and now she's back to square one - homelessness. 

That was a difficult scene to watch. Her loneliness always hits me hardest, because she's so desperate to be part of a family. 

Neyse, Alya rejects Erol's offer to represent her and decides she doesn't want anything to do with Cihan. She blames him, but not really; does that make sense?

Like, for example, when Cihan asks Alya to leave, he has a myriad of things running through his head. Sure, foremost is the hurt he feels when Alya leaves, but then there's Zerrin's bitter words, Alya's fear, and his own guilt. 

Also, when someone you love a whole lot has even the slightest to do with an event that hurts you, the bulk of your anger naturally finds its way towards them. 

Just like you can only hurt people you love, you can only be truly offended by someone you love. Otherwise, who'd think twice if it were a stranger?

Now, going back to the concept of bedel ver - Alya makes a deal with Ecmel, whom she knows can't be trusted. Can we say her ending up in jail is life's way of showing her to wake up? The cost of innocence in a brutal landscape like Mardin? 

Yes, I think so. Even though I understand Alya's desperation in making the deal, and her isolation and helplessness. 

What about Cihan? Mr. Bedel himself? When Cihan continues pouring out his anger on Alya and keeps insisting that whatever is between them is over, does he realize his actions will have consequences? Yes, he does. In this episode, when it's too little, too late. 

CihAl's conversation in jail, where Alya says she blames Cihan, isn't unlike Cihan blaming Alya alone for leaving. Folks can say Alya was being over-the-top until they're blue in the face; I don't think so. She has reason to be wary of Cihan now, thanks to Cihan's own doing. 

And worse, the situation that lands her in jail does overtly benefit Sadakat and him, because isn't he the one who keeps saying Deniz will stay in Mardin, but Alya can leave if she wants. 

Now, the audience knows Deniz is the convenient shield Ciho is hiding behind to hang on to Alya, but Alya doesn't.

Plus, she's 100 percent right to suspect Sadakat (this is where you understand she doesn't really suspect Ciho), who's tried to have her jailed several times, shot her, tried to throw her out of the konak, disrespected her being, her motherhood, everything about her. 

Not to mention, Alya sees firsthand what's happening to Zerrin. So, from her POV, the bigger danger is Sadakat (and I kind of suspect the same). Listening to Alya dissect the situation so carefully and pointing out that Ecmel doesn't benefit outright shakes Cihan. 

Because he can see his attempts at distancing her have succeeded to quite an extent and at the worst possible time. Bedel ver, indeed. 

The next character I want to talk about briefly in this context is Sadakat. Fate makes it so that this woman ends her own son's life - quite the high cost for all the evil she's done. 

But does that soften the woman? Nope. Does that make her question her actions and her heartlessness? Not really.

If anything, she turns even worse. When Cihan questions her involvement in the event, she turns around and stings him in the wound she knows will hurt the most. It will bleed the most. 

Why? Because Cihan dares to question her? This is a character who refuses to learn. 

At least Alya realizes in her heart of hearts that her leaving Cihan and Cihan's consequent anger are her fault, and that's why she absorbs his resentment to an extent. At least Cihan realizes that Alya's hurt stems from him asking her to leave and wants to fix that but doesn't know how. 

Sadakat doesn't realize why she was the one who ended up paying the price she did at all. She's even more ruthless against her own children. 

Against Alya and Nare. And notice, in her talk with Kaya, she conveniently mentions, 'If Cihan and Simal are to stay at the konak, there will be a price to pay. And it will be paid.'

Coincidence? I think not. Y'all remember how she keeps hounding Alya, saying she'll be the reason one of her sons is killed? And what happens? One of her sons does die, but at her own hands, because of her own actions. 

Which is why I have a feeling fate isn't done with Sadakat, yet. Since she's so fond of paying the cost, maybe fate has something else lined up for her in the future. She has it coming. 

(Shoutout to the scene where Kaya asks Ipek to stop kissing Sadakat's a*s, because even he can't take her a*skissery anymore.)

What else? Oh, yeah, Cihan's constant descent into apprehension throughout the episode because he now knows something is definitely up with Alya health-wise (one word, starts with a P and ends with a T), but Alya won't talk to him anymore. 

That was a neat little touch. I have a feeling next episode, we'll see more of Alya's hidden feelings. 

One thing to notice during the scene where both Alya and Ciho have their flashbacks to Mabel Matiz's 'haram geceler,' is that they both realize how much they're hurting each other. 

Alya remembers Cihan asking if she really believes him, low enough to frame her using Deniz, and Cihan remembers Alya saying she's stuck in jail, alone and helpless again, because she refused to let her leave. 

And this is where the episode quietly brings us back to the heart of the whole CihAl conflict - they both know they’re hurting each other, but neither knows how to stop. But that doesn't stop them from longing for each other (Senin için ağlıyorum, about says it all.)

Their flashbacks almost mirror one another. It’s that whole matching wounds thing again. Neither of them is innocent, but neither is entirely to blame either. 

They’re both acting from pain, pride, fear, and love that neither of them seems capable of turning off. Another aspect of bedel that they're imposing on themselves as long as they let pride and hurt win against love. 

And now for that threat that had everyone spiraling for days on end. I don't want to keep repeating the bedel bit, but my goodness, Cihan and Alya are making me. 

One says he won't let Deniz go without stating the real reason, and then screams, to make matters worse. While the other responds to that authoritative stubbornness with a threat born of desperation that has no real merit to it. 

We all know, including Cihan, that Alya would never go that far. Which is why he will likely egg her on with his own parting shot, 'see if I care,' and we'll see that whole cycle start again. So, how do we get past the stalemate?

When the music stops, I guess. 

That's all from me until now. I'll see you next week :D

text:
A professional poker player bet $30,000 he could handle a quiet, peaceful life.

He surrendered in 48 hours and paid a $15,000 penalty just to escape it.

Annie Duke exposed this story at Google to uncover the most expensive psychological trap in career moves.

John Hennigan was a high-stakes poker legend living in Las Vegas.

He made a $30,000 bet that he could spend 30 days living in Des Moines, Iowa. No gambling, no nightlife, just a quiet street and a golf course.

He was 100% convinced he could handle it easily.

48 hours later, Hennigan went insane from the boredom.

He called his friends and offered them $15,000 in cash just to CANCEL the bet and let him leave.

They refused. He packed his bags, flew back to Vegas, and paid them the full $15,000 buyout.

You are making this exact same $15,000 mistake with your life right now:

• You quit a high-paying, stressful job for a "dream remote business" you’ve never run.
• You move across the country for a bigger salary without testing what an ordinary Tuesday feels like there.
• You romanticize a lifestyle you’ve only ever watched on a 6-inch phone screen.

You calculate the upside money. You NEVER calculate the psychological reality.

By the time you realize you hate it, your savings are trapped, your lease is signed, and your ego prevents you from admitting you failed.

Before you make a permanent career or life move, BUY SOME EVIDENCE FIRST:
1. Don't quit your job for a new venture — run a 14-day small-scale test on weekends.
2. Don't relocate to a new city — rent an Airbnb there for 2 weeks and work a regular schedule.
3. Find out what you hate while changing your mind is still CHEAP.

Confidence before experience is pure delusion.

Bookmark this before your next "dream career pivot" turns into an expensive prison you have to pay to escape.

text:
I bless thee Eddie in the Name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit! Amen!
Heavenly Father, I lift this beloved one into Your loving hands, asking that Your healing touch restore his body completely. Remove all heart problems, strokes, leukemia, cancer, disease, infirmary, injury, sickness, fatigue, or pain, and renew his strength, energy, and vitality. Grant wisdom and skill to the medical team, patience to this beloved one, and peace to his heart. Surround him with Your divine protection, and let Your presence comfort and reassure him. May Your grace and mercy flow through every part  Eddie’s being. In Jesus’ name I beg and pray, Amen.

Prayer to the Holy Spirit:
Come, Holy Spirit, Divine Comforter and Breath of Life. Enter all places of heart problems, cancer, tumors, pain, injury, disease, infection, suffering, weakness and fear. Remove every and all infirmary, and surround   Eddie with Your gentle light, while completely healing   Eddie while filling his heart with the strength and peace that comes from above, trusting to the power of God’s eternal love. Amen.

Pray to the Blessed Holy Mother Mary:

Dear Mother Mary, With hearts heavy and bodies burdened, we approach your divine presence, seeking your miraculous touch. Your healing power knows no equal, and in our times of need, we implore you to mend not only our physical wounds but the scars that mar our souls. Pour forth your divine grace upon us, dear Mother, and restore us to a state of wholeness, that we may bear witness to the miracle of your love. Amen.

Prayer to St. Jude:

Oh glorious apostle St. Jude, faithful servant and friend of Jesus, the name of the traitor who delivered thy beloved Master into the hands of His enemies has caused thee to be forgotten by many, but the Church honors and invokes thee universally as the patron of hopeless cases--of things despaired of. Pray for me who am so miserable; make use, I implore thee, of that particular privilege accorded thee of bringing visible and speedy help where help is almost despaired of. Come to my assistance in this great need, that I may receive the consolations and succor of heaven in all my necessities, tribulations and sufferings, particularly—completely heal from all heart problems, leukemia, injuries, cancer and diseases, and protect  Eddie—and that I may bless God with thee and all the elect throughout eternity. I promise thee, O blessed St. Jude, to be ever mindful of this great favor, and I will never cease to honor thee as my special and powerful patron, and to do all in my power to encourage devotion to thee. Amen

Prayer to St. Michael (Long Version)

O Glorious Prince of the heavenly host, Saint Michael the Archangel, defend us in the battle and fearful warfare that we are waging against the principalities and powers, against the rulers of this world of darkness, against the evil spirits. Come thou to the assistance of men, whom Almighty God created immortal, making them in His own image and likeness and redeeming them at a great price from the tyranny of Satan. Fight this day the battle of the Lord with thy legions of holy Angels, even as of old thou didst fight against Lucifer, the leader of the proud spirits and all his rebel angels, who were powerless to stand against thee, neither was their place found any more in heaven. And that great dragon was cast forth, the ancient serpent, who is called the devil and satan, who seduces the whole world; and he was cast forth upon Earth, and his angels were sent with him.

But behold! the ancient enemy of mankind and a murderer from the beginning has been fiercely aroused. Changing himself into an angel of light, he goes about with the whole multitude of the wicked spirits to invade the earth and blot out the Name of God and of His Christ, to plunder, to slay, and to consign to eternal damnation the souls that have been destined for a crown of everlasting life. This wicked serpent, like an unclean torrent, pours into men of depraved minds and corrupt hearts the poison of his malice, the spirit of lying, impiety and blasphemy, and the deadly breath of impurity and every form of vice and iniquity.

Be favorable to Thy Church, the Bride of the Lamb without spot, whose enemies have filled to overflowing with gall and inebriated with wormwood. They have laid profane hands upon Her most sacred treasures. Where the See of the most blessed Peter and the Chair of Truth has been constituted as a light to the nations, there they have placed a throne of their abomination and impiety; so that with the Pastor struck, they may prevail to disperse the flock.

Therefore, most invincible Leader, be with the people of God against this spiritual wickedness and bring about victory. Thou art venerated by Holy Church as Her guard and patron; Thou art glorified as our defender against the impious powers of earth and of hell. Unto thee the Lord hath handed over the souls of the redeemed to be placed in happiness above.

Entreat the God of peace, to obliterate satan beneath our feet, lest he prevail further to hold men captive, and to injure the Church. Offer our prayers in the sight of the Most High, so that the mercy of the Lord may swiftly overtake us, and apprehend the dragon, the ancient serpent, who is the devil and satan, and send him bound into the abyss, so that he may seduce the nations no more.

Henceforth having been confided to thy escort and protection, we sacred ministers by the authority of the Holy Mother Church [if recited by a cleric of the order of exorcist or above, say instead: by our authority], do undertake to repel the infestations of diabolical deceit in the Name of Jesus Christ, Our God and Lord.

Behold the Cross of the Lord; be scattered hostile powers.
The Lion of the tribe of Juda has conquered, the root of David.
Let Thy mercies be upon us, O Lord.
As we have hoped in Thee.
O Lord, hear my prayer.
And let my cry come unto Thee.
The Lord be with you all.
And with thy spirit.

Let us pray.
O God, and Father of Our Lord Jesus Christ, we invoke Thy Holy Name, and we humbly implore Thy clemency so that, through the intercession of Mary, the Immaculate ever-Virgin Mother of God, of blessed Michael the Archangel, of blessed Joseph, the Spouse of the same blessed Virgin, of the blessed Apostles Peter and Paul, and of all the Saints, Thou may deign to offer us aid against satan, and all the other unclean spirits, who wander through the world to injure the human race and to destroy souls. We ask this through Christ Our Lord. Amen.

Prayer for possible any evil influence:

In His Name and by the power of His Cross and Blood, I ask Jesus Christ to bind any evil spirits, forces and powers of the earth, air, fire, water, and of the netherworld and all of the satanic forces of nature. By the power of the Holy Spirit and by His authority, I ask Jesus Christ to break any and all curses, hexes, vexes, jinks, spells, and all wrong prayers and words, and to send them all back to where they came from, if it be His Holy Will. I beseech Thee, Lord Jesus Christ, to protect us by pouring Thy Precious Blood on us; myself, my family, my friends, and all those I pray and intercede for; which Thou hast shed for us and I ask Thee to command that any departing spirits leave quietly, without disturbance, and go straight to Thy Cross to be disposed of as Thou sees fit. I ask Thee to bind any demonic interactions, interplay, or communications. I place myself, my family, my friends, and all those I pray and intercede for, and all things I pray and intercede for under the protection of the Blood of Jesus Christ which He has shed for us. Amen.

Prayer for Surgery (In case needed.)

Lord Almighty, I lift up this beloved one  Eddie, as he faces surgery. Protect him, guide the hands of doctors and nurses, and grant wisdom in every decision. Remove fear, anxiety, and complications, replacing them with Your peace and assurance. Restore his health, strength, and vitality quickly, and surround them with Your loving presence. Comfort his heart, strengthen their spirit, and let Your healing flow through Eddie’s body. May he recover fully, trusting Your mercy and experiencing Your grace throughout this trial. Amen.

Lord Jesus, Divine Physician, we kneel before you. Because your love is all-powerful, we ask you to stretch forth your healing hand upon Eddie. Strengthen him to accept this cross of suffering, and if it be your will, grant Lord Jesus, Divine Physician, we kneel before you. Because your love is all-powerful, we ask you to stretch forth your healing hand upon Eddie. Strengthen him to accept this cross of suffering, and if it be your will, grant Eddie a miraculous healing, that your mercy may be made known. Amen.

Lord Jesus, we come to you with faith and ask you to cover us with your precious blood. Lord, grant us your healing peace. Amen.

Hail, holy Queen, Mother of Mercy, our life, our sweetness and our hope. To you do we cry, poor banished children of Eve; to you do we send up our sighs, mourning and weeping in this valley of tears. Turn then, most gracious advocate, your eyes of mercy toward us; and after this, our exile, show unto us the blessed fruit of your womb, Jesus. O clement, O loving, O sweet Virgin Mary.

Immaculate Mother of God, Our Lady of Lourdes, you chose to appear in a desolate grotto to a simple child. We come to you with boundless confidence to implore your intercession. Look upon us with your merciful eyes, especially upon Eddie who suffers from medical problems and is ill. Obtain for him the healing and relief that we seek, and above all, grant us the strength to accept God’s perfect will. Amen. a miraculous healing, that your mercy may be made known. Amen.

text:
Listen, the objection is not that Jews are magically entitled to a homeland and everyone else must shut up. The objection is that you have just voted to declare the existence of the only liberal state in the Levant a form of racism, while the movement you are protecting has spent a century trying to erase that state.

Jewish self-determination does not “require the destruction” of Palestinian self-determination. That is a slogan, not an argument. Partition was offered in 1937, 1947, 2000 and 2008. The Jewish side accepted a state on a fraction of the land; the Arab side chose war, rejection and, later, a charter that called for the killing of Jews. Two peoples can have states. One people has repeatedly refused any outcome in which the other survives as a sovereign nation. Calling that refusal “self-determination” is how you launder eliminationism.

Nor is Western support for Israel a sentimental attachment to Zionism. Most of the people you are lecturing do not care about Herzl. They care that a strip of coastline the size of Wales is a functioning democracy, with independent courts, a free press, gay tights and women who can drive, vote and divorce, planted in the middle of an absolutist political ideology that refuses to compromise with any of those things. That ideology is not “the Palestinians.” It is the jihadist current; Muslim Brotherhood, Hamas, Hezbollah, the Iranian axis, that treats Jewish sovereignty, Christian presence, female autonomy and secular law as offences to be corrected by slaughter. Israel is the dagger in its heart. Every rocket, tunnel and massacre aimed at Israeli civilians is also a proof of concept for what that current would do, at larger scale, to the societies you live in but seek to undermine.

You can dislike Netanyahu. You can argue about settlements. You cannot pretend that abolishing the Jewish state would produce a second Denmark between the river and the sea. The neighbours who have already tried that experiment produced Hamas rule, pay-for-slay, and a leadership that still teaches its children that the whole map is theirs and that every Jew, every Christian must be annihilated. Westerners who grasp this are not confused about Jewish self-determination. They have noticed who keeps trying to murder their own, and who, inconveniently, keeps stopping them.

God preserve Israel.

COMPETITION IS ELIMINATED UNDER A SOCIALIST “COLLECTIVE OWNERSHIP” FRAMEWORK

Thou art venerated by Holy Church as Her guard and patron; Thou art glorified as our defender against the impious powers of earth and of hell. Unto thee the Lord hath handed over the souls of the redeemed to be placed in happiness above.

Entreat the God of peace, to obliterate satan beneath our feet, lest he prevail further to hold men captive, and to injure the Church. Offer our prayers in the sight of the Most High, so that the mercy of the Lord may swiftly overtake us, and apprehend the dragon, the ancient serpent, who is the devil and satan, and send him bound into the abyss, so that he may seduce the nations no more.

Henceforth having been confided to thy escort and protection, we sacred ministers by the authority of the Holy Mother Church [if recited by a cleric of the order of exorcist or above, say instead: by our authority], do undertake to repel the infestations of diabolical deceit in the Name of Jesus Christ, Our God and Lord.

Behold the Cross of the Lord; be scattered hostile powers.
The Lion of the tribe of Juda has conquered, the root of David.
Let Thy mercies be upon us, O Lord.
As we have hoped in Thee.
O Lord, hear my prayer.
And let my cry come unto Thee.
The Lord be with you all.
And with thy spirit.

Let us pray.
O God, and Father of Our Lord Jesus Christ, we invoke Thy Holy Name, and we humbly implore Thy clemency so that, through the intercession of Mary, the Immaculate ever-Virgin Mother of God, of blessed Michael the Archangel, of blessed Joseph, the Spouse of the same blessed Virgin, of the blessed Apostles Peter and Paul, and of all the Saints, Thou may deign to offer us aid against satan, and all the other unclean spirits, who wander through the world to injure the human race and to destroy souls. We ask this through Christ Our Lord. Amen.

In His Name and by the power of His Cross and Blood, I ask Jesus Christ to bind any evil spirits, forces and powers of the earth, air, fire, water, and of the netherworld and all of the satanic forces of nature. By the power of the Holy Spirit and by His authority, I ask Jesus Christ to break any and all curses, hexes, vexes, jinks, spells, and all wrong prayers and words, and to send them all back to where they came from, if it be His Holy Will. I beseech Thee, Lord Jesus Christ, to protect us by pouring Thy Precious Blood on us; myself, my family, my friends, and all those I pray and intercede for; which Thou hast shed for us and I ask Thee to command that any departing spirits leave quietly, without disturbance, and go straight to Thy Cross to be disposed of as Thou sees fit. I ask Thee to bind any demonic interactions, interplay, or communications. I place myself, my family, my friends, and all those I pray and intercede for, and all things I pray and intercede for under the protection of the Blood of Jesus Christ which He has shed for us. Amen.

Remove her fear, anxiety, and complications, replacing them with Your peace and assurance. Restore her health, strength, and vitality quickly, and surround her with Your loving presence. Comfort her heart, strengthen her spirit, and let Your healing flow through Whitney’s body. May they recover fully, trusting Your mercy and experiencing Your grace throughout this trial. Amen.

Lord Jesus, Divine Physician, we kneel before you. Because your love is all-powerful, we ask you to stretch forth your healing hand upon Whitney. Strengthen her to accept this cross of suffering, and if it be your will, grant Whitney a miraculous healing, that your mercy may be made known. Amen.

Lord Jesus, we come to you with faith and ask you to cover Whitney with your precious blood. Lord, grant Whitney your healing peace. Amen.

Hail, holy Queen, Mother of Mercy, our life, our sweetness and our hope. To you do we cry, poor banished children of Eve; to you do we send up our sighs, mourning and weeping in this valley of tears. Turn then, most gracious advocate, your eyes of mercy toward us; and after this, our exile, show unto us the blessed fruit of your womb, Jesus. O clement, O loving, O sweet Virgin Mary.

Immaculate Mother of God, Our Lady of Lourdes, you chose to appear in a desolate grotto to a simple child. We come to you with boundless confidence to implore your intercession. Look upon us with your merciful eyes, especially upon Whitney who suffers from breast cancer. Obtain for her the healing and relief that she seeks, and above all, grant her the strength to accept God’s perfect will. Amen.

text:
I don’t generally pay that much attention but the negative comments I read appear to me to be from people who listen to other people and don’t bother to do their own research. Here is what I found out

Pete eliminated DEI offices and initiatives throughout the Department of Defense and directed the military back toward merit-based policies—placing qualifications, performance and readiness ahead of race or sex. The Pentagon later reported that the DEI-elimination directive had been implemented department-wide.  

He ordered a military-wide review of physical fitness, body composition and grooming standards. For combat jobs, he directed the services to develop physical standards based on the actual demands of the job rather than having different requirements based on sex.  

He welcomed back service members who had been separated over the COVID-19 vaccine mandate. The Pentagon said nearly 8,000 active-duty and reserve personnel had been involuntarily separated, and eligible troops were offered a route back, including restoration of rank and back pay in qualifying cases.  

Military recruiting and retention improved dramatically. Early in his tenure all five services met their February 2025 recruiting goals, and the Army reported reaching its 12-month retention goal six months early.  

He started attacking Pentagon waste and bureaucracy. In his first 100 days, the department identified billions of dollars for potential redirection, terminated hundreds of millions in contracts it considered unnecessary, and ordered billions more in reductions involving consulting and IT services so resources could be shifted toward military priorities.  

He pushed major acquisition reform because America’s weapons-buying system can take years to deliver new technology. He ordered reviews of major defense acquisition programs and emphasized faster software and weapons procurement so troops can receive useful technology sooner.  

He ordered the Army to move away from obsolete and redundant equipment and put more resources into long-range precision weapons, missile defense, cyber warfare, electronic warfare and counter-space capabilities.  

He accelerated drones and counter-drone technology. His Army transformation directive called for unmanned systems in every division by the end of 2026 and improved counter-drone capabilities down to maneuver units.  

He pushed artificial intelligence and advanced manufacturing into military operations, including AI-assisted command-and-control systems and expanded use of technologies such as 3-D printing closer to operational units.  

He worked on rebuilding America’s defense industrial base—expanding ammunition production, strengthening domestic critical-mineral supplies and addressing shipbuilding and supply-chain weaknesses.  

He pushed America’s NATO allies to carry more of the cost of their own defense instead of relying so heavily on American taxpayers. NATO members subsequently committed to a new 5% defense-and-security spending target, although that was an achievement involving President Trump and the entire administration, not Hegseth alone.  

And he made his overall priority very clear: combat readiness, military standards, merit, accountability and deterrence.

So criticize Pete Hegseth when he makes a mistake. I have no problem with that. But calling him an “idiot” and “the most incompetent Secretary of Defense” while mentioning none of this isn’t an argument—it’s name-calling.

I use AI to check people’s records instead of simply believing political memes. I suggest everyone do their own research and decide for themselves.

text:
Welcome to your early October Kent Wildlife Trust e-newsletter. We've got a few updates for you in this edition, from an exciting free course on offer and the latest pictures from our reserves to a wellbeing programme in Tunbridge Wells, plus a notice about Sevenoaks.

Volunteers' Week

Fungi season is here!

📷 Fungi pictures from across our reserves

The sheer diversity of fungi is really something to behold - from classic fairytale toadstools to gloopy brackets and coral-like structures. And they're certainly putting on a show on our reserves at the moment!

Interested to learn more about some of the weird, wonderful and familiar fungi you might spot this autumn?

Check out our free beginner's guide to fungi email course, open now... 👀

Sign up here

Notice: Short planned disruption to Sevenoaks Wildlife Reserve car park 

(12-16 October)

From 12-16 October, the car park will not be accessible via the main entrance barrier due to necessary felling works, and some spaces will be unavailable. However, parking will still be open via the exit barrier, in the overflow area.

The Visitor Centre will remain open throughout the duration of the works and any disruption to bookable activities will be communicated well in advance. We thank our visitors for their patience and understanding during these works. Find out more and read the FAQs here.

Save Oaken Wood

The public consultation for the Draft Kent Mineral Sites Plan (Regulation 19) has now closed.

Members of the public and organisations have commented on whether the Plan is legally compliant and sound, including whether it has been positively prepared, justified, effective and consistent with national planning policy. Thank you to everyone who submitted a response - you have given nature a voice. 💚

We're now waiting to see what the timeline will be for the examination and will keep you updated!

Take part in the 2026/27 awards

The Wilder Kent Awards celebrate the brilliant ways local people, community groups, education providers, councils, businesses, and organisations are making Kent a better place for nature.

Maidstone Borough Council was just one of our fantastic gold winners from 2025/26. Here's a bit about them to get you inspired!

Maidstone Borough Council are striving to create a Wilder Kent through a dizzying number of projects that were heartening to read about. Many of the actions have been truly innovative and we hope that other borough and city councils will follow Maidstone’s lead. Some of these projects include the introduction of a Landscape Enforcement Officer within the planning team, soil trials taking place at the Chillington Street Site, the introduction of a fully electric refuse truck and the black poplar propagation programme. Well done Maidstone Borough Council!

📷©️ AllaStratiienko

Whether you're signed up or not, autumn is a fantastic time to think about the impact you can have for wildlife for the rest of the year. Learn more about how the Awards work, read about our previous winners, and take part over on our website!

Learn more

Wilder Wellbeing for 25-40 year-olds

Join us at Grosvenor and Hilbert Park for a free six-week Wilder Wellbeing Programme. The programme is open to adults aged 25-40 living in the Tunbridge Wells area who are wanting to improve their physical, mental and social wellbeing.

Sessions include gentle walks, nature-based crafts, and relaxation techniques in a friendly small-group setting.

Sign up here

Catch up with more updates, events, and news on our social media or our website.

Thank you for your continued support of Kent Wildlife Trust!

All the best,

Rosie

text:
Before America knew him as Oliver Wendell Douglas, Eddie Albert was a lieutenant junior grade on a Higgins boat at Tarawa.
November 1943. Betio. The reef stopped the landing craft hundreds of yards out, so Marines had to wade in under machine-gun fire. Albert’s job was salvage. Pick up reusable gear after the troops were ashore.
He looked at the water and changed the job.
Wounded men were waist-deep on the reef, the tide coming in, guns sweeping the lagoon. He took the boat back in. Then again. Then again. On one run the deck sat so low under the weight of the men that it was under the waterline. On another he found a handful of Marines who had lost their rifles in the surf. He offered to pull them out. They said no. Just bring us something to fight with. He went back for rifles. When he returned, they were dead.
He later said that day mattered more to him than anything he did on a soundstage.
The Bronze Star with the Combat “V” was real. The ceremony was not until 1997. The Navy had filed the record under his birth name, Edward Albert Heimberger, and nobody could match it to the actor.
Green Acres made him famous. Tarawa is what he kept.
